A.text: Bromoethane reacts with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ to form ethene as a major product.

B.text: 1-chlorobutane reacts more rapidly than 1-bromobutane with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ at the same temperature.

C.text: Hydrolysis of $\text{(C}_2\text{H}_5\text{)}_3\text{CBr}$ occurs mostly by the $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.

D.text: The $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2^{+}$ ion is less stable than the $\text{(CH}_3\text{)}_3\text{C}^{+}$ ion.
